prompts.ATTACK: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent enemy sprite for a high-end dark fantasy 2D collectible RPG, not a UI badge. A newly designed magical sealing orb that imprisons an ancient obsidian dragon: a large luminous spherical crystal core physically bound by weathered bronze dragon-scale clamps, sculpted metal ribs and heavy short chain links. Cohesive hand-painted dark fantasy illustration, finely etched metal and painterly crystal, readable strong silhouette at small size. One complete freestanding levitating orb assembly, centered in square canvas, three-quarter frontal view. Entire core, ornate outer restraints, chains and restrained magical light fit comfortably inside the canvas with at least 8% clear padding on every side. No ground, no floor shadow, no scenery, no character, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no UI border. Genuine transparent background with clean alpha; dark outer metal must remain visible through bronze edge highlights, glow confined close to the object. Broad crystal occupies roughly half the full assembly width. Avoid cartoon simplicity, neon plastic, white or black background rectangles, tiny noisy trinkets, flat medallion/icon design. Variant: DESTRUCTION seal. A deep garnet and molten crimson spherical core with luminous red-orange branching stress fissures. Three powerful asymmetrical jawlike bronze claw clamps and angular forged obsidian armor spikes squeeze the core. A partial tilted bronze meridian hoop engraved with abstract nonlinguistic grooves, short taut chains binding its ribs. Menacing aggressive serrated silhouette, tangible ancient relic material, dense controlled crimson energy sealed inside; no explosion, no flames obscuring the core. 1024x1024 composition.
